tools.name: browser.open
tools.description: Navigate the controlled browser to a validated public http(s) URL and record the page as a source.

tools.name: browser.extract
tools.description: Extract description, headings, displayed prices and audience signals from the current page.

tools.name: browser.screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot of the current page as visual evidence.

tools.name: research.collect
tools.description: For one research target: open each official URL (browser.open), extract observations (browser.extract) and capture a screenshot (browser.screenshot). Inaccessible sources are recorded as failures.

tools.name: analysis.compare
tools.description: Compare captured evidence across competitors: positioning, audiences, differentiators and market gaps. Claude-grounded when configured, rule-based otherwise.

tools.name: artifact.write
tools.description: Render an artifact from observed tool outputs and write it inside the mission artifact directory.

tools.name: artifact.read
tools.description: Read an artifact back from the mission directory and report its size and a short preview.

tools.name: artifact.delete
tools.description: Delete an artifact from the mission directory. Consequential: always requires explicit approval.

tools.name: verifier.check
tools.description: Independently verify artifacts: read back from disk, parse, check structure, coverage and citations, and re-ground every excerpt against stored captures.

tools.name: report.finalize
tools.description: Write verification-report.md and the mission summary from computed execution results.
